levels.name: GENERATIVE_AI
levels.definition: Produces grounded text, code, reports, and content from governed knowledge and user instructions.

levels.name: AGENTIC_AI
levels.definition: Plans, decomposes goals, selects approved tools, executes permitted steps, and reports evidence under policy gates.

levels.name: MULTI_AGENT_SYSTEMS
levels.definition: Coordinates specialized agents with roles, boundaries, audit, and escalation for complex institutional workflows.

levels.name: AGI
levels.definition: Research classification for broad human-like cognitive flexibility across domains.

levels.name: ASI
levels.definition: Risk-governance classification for hypothetical systems exceeding human capability.
